title: Real-Time In-App Candidate & Recruiter Messaging 10/10 Overhaul (enableMessagesModule Gating, Candidate Surface Mounting & Live Unread Badging)
spec:
# DIR-026: Real-Time In-App Candidate & Recruiter Messaging 10/10 Overhaul

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives
In `System Settings > Addon & Feature Modules Manager`, the **Messages & Chat Module** (`enableMessagesModule`) is defined as:
> "Allows job seekers, recruiters, and employers to communicate via real-time direct messaging with unread badges."

Currently, while `src/components/Dashboard/DashboardMessages/DashboardMessages.jsx` exists and `/employer/messages` is mounted in the Employer Portal, the Candidate side is completely broken:
1. `/dashboard/messages` is **NOT mounted** in `DashboardMain.jsx`.
2. Candidates have no navigation link or unread counter badge in the Google M3 Header or sidebar.
3. When an administrator toggles `enableMessagesModule: false`, the backend `/api/messages/*` endpoints still accept requests, and `/employer/messages` remains visible.

This directive mandates a complete 10/10 overhaul of the Messaging workflow across both Candidate and Recruiter portals, establishing clean route mounting, Cuba design tokens, real-time unread badging, strict admin toggle enforcement across frontend and backend, and dedicated Playwright E2E verification.

## 2. Key Architecture Directives
1. **Candidate Messages Surface (`/dashboard/messages`)**:
   - Mount `<Route path="messages" element={<DashboardMessages showToast={showToast} />} />` in `DashboardMain.jsx`.
   - Wrap in Cuba design tokens (`--cuba-card`, `--cuba-line`, `--cuba-ink`, `--cuba-primary-fill`).

2. **Google M3 AppHeader & Sidebar Unread Badging**:
   - Add a Chat/Messages icon in `CubaCandidateShell.jsx` and `EmployerSidebar.jsx` showing a live unread count badge.
   - Sync unread counts periodically via `/api/messages/conversations` (3-query bounded MariaDB pattern).

3. **Admin Module Toggle Enforcement**:
   - Frontend: If `enableMessagesModule === false`, suppress messages links from navigation shells and gracefully redirect direct route visits to `/dashboard` with an info toast.
   - Backend: In `backend/index.js` messaging middleware, check `modules.enableMessagesModule`. If disabled, return `HTTP 403 { code: 'MODULE_DISABLED' }`.

4. **Dedicated Playwright E2E Verification**:
   - Author `playwright.dir026.config.js` targeting `tests/e2e/dir026-messaging.spec.js`.
   - Verify candidate sends message, recruiter receives message, unread badge increments, and toggle-off hides surface.
invariants: INV-1: Frozen Baseline Integrity: git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js must remain STRICTLY 0 bytes (57 CV templates + AI runtime frozen).

INV-2: Authentic MariaDB Grounding: All conversations, messages, participant links, and timestamps must persist to authoritative MariaDB tables with strictly zero synthetic mock arrays or client-side storage shortcuts.

INV-3: Participant Isolation: Users must strictly query and receive only conversations where their authenticated UID is in conversation_participants. Cross-tenant or unauthorized message reads must return 403/404.
INV-4: WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility: Contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 across chat bubbles, unread badges, and input surface in both light and dark themes.
INV-5: Performance Budget: Sub-100ms message delivery render; bundle build duration < 4.0s.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Mount Candidate Messages Surface: In src/components/Dashboard/DashboardMain/DashboardMain.jsx, mount Route path="messages" rendering DashboardMessages.jsx (lazy loaded), wrapped in Cuba Candidate shell.

AC-2: Header Navigation & Unread Badging: In CubaCandidateShell.jsx and M3UserMenu.jsx, add Messages navigation item with live unread counter badge (polling /api/messages/conversations every 15s or on route focus).

AC-3: Admin Toggle Enforcement (Frontend): When enableMessagesModule is false, hide messages link from candidate and recruiter navigation shells, and redirect /dashboard/messages and /employer/messages to dashboard home with an info toast.

AC-4: Admin Toggle Enforcement (Backend): In backend/index.js (under /api/messages router), read system_settings public_config.modules.enableMessagesModule. If disabled, return HTTP 403 { success: false, code: 'MODULE_DISABLED', error: 'Messaging module is disabled by administrator.' }.

AC-5: Real-Time Conversation Sync & Error Recovery: Verify getConversations and sendMessage reliably exchange messages between candidate and recruiter across MariaDB tables conversations, conversation_participants, and messages with zero Firebase Firestore reliance.

AC-6: Dedicated Playwright E2E Suite (playwright.dir026.config.js & tests/e2e/dir026-messaging.spec.js): 100% passing tests against live dev server verifying candidate-recruiter messaging thread, message send, unread counter update, and toggle disabling behavior.
AC-7: Quality Gates Pass: vite build < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm test zero regressions.
